summary: Toronto-Dominion Bank filed a 424B5 preliminary pricing supplement for a proposed offering of US$ Floating Rate Senior Medium-Term Notes, Series F. The notes are unsecured, bail-inable obligations, not listed on any exchange. TD Securities (USA) LLC acts as joint book-running manager. No merger, acquisition, or special situation event is involved. This filing is a routine debt capital markets transaction. There are no special-situation terms to analyze; the offering is a standard medium-term note issuance under an existing shelf registration.
